intent: Freeze the known-good pre-RVA23S64-full subset as the regression floor.

selection_policy.zfh_filter: Only the locally verified Zfhmin conversion subset is selected from Zfh tests.
selection_policy.svnapot_filter: vm_reserved_svnapot_S_mode.S is excluded because it is a negative test for cores without Svnapot.

known_waivers_and_non_claims: This profile is the current scalar/profile-support subset, not full RVA23S64.
Full base V, vector profile support, Zvbb claimability, and Zvkt remain unclaimed despite directed-tested vector slices.
Zawrs, Sstc, Sscofpmf, Zic64b, Ziccif, Ziccrse, Ziccamoa, Zicclsm, Za64rs, and Svpbmt remain implemented-assumption or partial surfaces that are not declared in borb_isa.yaml.
Zfh is declared as a local riscv-config workaround for the implemented Zfhmin conversion subset required by Zfa tooling.
Linux/OpenSBI, guest bring-up, SMP, full hypervisor, and OS-level profile validation are not part of the current subset.
